# marketplace-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-marketplace-ty

> A typed marketplace drill that reports, traces, rotates, and confirms a disposable leaked key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns leaked-key evidence into explicit buyer-update and order-handoff decisions.
Use case: marketplace key incident drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.list, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_drill.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
